assumptions: Rate method: assumed_net_rate
Pointing: ideal_pointing
Service: Assumed finite six-hour educational service; no operator allocation
Real matched DE421 SPICE states and published LOLA terrain grids; assumed hardware, service, pointing and net radio rates.
Generation is the minimum of endpoint and midpoint samples per 60-second bin, held constant by assumption; no continuous power guarantee.
Contacts require clear endpoint and midpoint finite-segment samples per 60-second bin with 30-second outer guards; unsampled short events may be missed.
Same-epoch geometric rays omit retarded endpoint geometry; a positive constant upper-model delay is separately applied to receiver service and byte arrival.
Constant contact delay uses maximum sampled geometric range plus 60 seconds at an assumed 12 km/s range-rate bound.
Terrain above the reference sphere is bounded by an assumed 12 km global envelope; low-altitude finite ray samples use real numerical DEM values.
Fixed-panel center-ray projection, sampled uniform Sun disk and same-ray spherical Earth eclipse mask; no temperature or self-shadowing model.
Synthetic relay conics omit nonspherical gravity, third bodies and radiation pressure; they are not operational frozen or libration-point orbits.
Whole dataset uses direct contacts or one selected lunar store-and-forward relay; Earth-orbit relays disabled.
Payload durations rounded upward to an event-grid boundary; padded payload occupancy consumes declared radio power.
Radio conflicts and electrical loads conservatively reserve every intersected event bin.
Acquisition and teardown use the terminal TX or RX electrical draw respectively.
Relay buffer reserves a complete chunk at reception start and releases it after outgoing payload completion.
Ground sink retains all received chunks with finite configured station storage.
Policy: satisfy deadline and constraints, then fewer relay hops, earlier final arrival, lower lander communications energy.
SYNTHETIC external relay power assumed sufficient only during declared service; battery/base loads not modeled
Ground stations use externally powered service; station battery/base loads are outside the frozen profile.

antenna.proof_scope: For terrain radius at most the declared outer radius, apparent elevation is bounded by the outer sphere and decreases beyond this extent. The cap is an assumption, not a measured global guarantee.

panel.proof_scope: For terrain radius at most the declared outer radius, apparent elevation is bounded by the outer sphere and decreases beyond this extent. The cap is an assumption, not a measured global guarantee.

limiting_reason: The complete dataset schedule passed independent byte, timing, resource and energy replay under the declared assumptions.

details.buffer_conservatism: reserve incoming whole chunk at first arrival; release at transmit end

warnings: Published grid interpolation is modeled terrain, not a measured surface at every pixel.
Fine-grid gaps use the explicitly declared coarse LOLA grid; both-source gaps remain unknown.
Extent convergence does not prove radial or angular sampling completeness.
This is an assumed-rate planning simulation, with no RF link closure or operational station/relay access claim.
Geometry and power are discrete sampled approximations; feasible results apply only under these declared assumptions.
Unknown opportunities were excluded. A replayed schedule on known contacts can establish feasibility under assumptions; infeasibility and optimality over the full network remain unproved.
Published terrain and ephemerides feed this model; radio rates, service and synthetic relay trajectories remain declared assumptions, not mission predictions.
This result does not book service or certify navigation, relay operation or thermal survival.
Scientific map placement depends on the run's versioned renderer registration and its tested region; rendered terrain does not resolve numerical coverage.
